description: This Java source file defines the ArtifactInfoFactory class, which manages and provides access to various artifact information objects (entities, services, forms, screens, controllers) within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading, caching, and retrieving artifact metadata, as well as preparing analysis tasks for components and services.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoFactory
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing and retrieving artifact information objects within the OFBiz framework, including entities, services, forms, screens, and controllers. It handles caching, loading, and analysis task preparation for these artifacts.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoFactory
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of ArtifactInfoFactory for a given delegator name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: prepareAll
methods.description: Loads and initializes all artifact info objects, including entities, services, and component components, in parallel.

methods.name: getEntityArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the EntityArtifactInfo object for a given entity name, creating and populating it if not already cached.

methods.name: getServiceArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ServiceArtifactInfo object for a given service name, creating and populating it if not already cached.

methods.name: getFormWidgetArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the FormWidgetArtifactInfo object for specified form name and location, creating and populating it if not cached.

methods.name: getScreenWidgetArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo object for specified screen name and location, creating and populating it if not cached.

methods.name: getControllerRequestArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ControllerRequestArtifactInfo object for specified controller URL and request URI, creating and populating it if not cached.

methods.name: getControllerViewArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ControllerViewArtifactInfo object for specified controller URL and view URI, creating it if not cached.
